sections.heading: Traffic signs and work zones
sections.markdown:
# Traffic signs and work zones

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
A No Turn on Red sign forbids a right turn during the red phase, so the driver must wait for green. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
A Stop Here on Red sign identifies the stopping location for a red signal. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A01
Without a No Turn on Red prohibition, a right turn on red is permitted after stopping at the line and checking traffic and pedestrians. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A01
A Do Not Block Intersection sign prohibits stopping, standing or parking in the intersection. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A01
Do not enter an intersection when traffic prevents clearing it completely. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A01
A Left Turn Yield on Green sign permits a left turn only after yielding to approaching traffic. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A01
On a one-way street, traffic must follow the sign’s arrow rather than travel in the opposite direction. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A01
A Do Not Pass sign marks a location where passing another vehicle is forbidden. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A01
Passing-zone decisions account for sight distance and hidden hazards such as curves, hills, intersections or entry points. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A01
A Pass with Care sign ends a no-passing zone but permits passing only when safe. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A01
A Keep Right sign directs traffic to the right of a feature such as a median, island or obstruction. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0033]

FACT_ID: sec04-R12 | anchor: A02
On a multilane highway, Slower Traffic Keep Right directs vehicles below the normal traffic speed to the right lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R13 | anchor: A02
The Do Not Enter design has a white horizontal bar inside a red circle and prohibits entering the roadway opening. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R14 | anchor: A02
A Wrong Way sign indicates that the vehicle is already traveling against the permitted direction. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R15 | anchor: A02
Wrong Way signs may appear beyond a Do Not Enter sign on a ramp or after an incorrect turn onto a one-way street, alley or driveway. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R16 | anchor: A02
A highway-evacuation sign identifies a route designated for emergency evacuation. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R17 | anchor: A02
A railroad crossbuck is required at public rail crossings and requires yielding to a train. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R18 | anchor: A02
Guide signs provide road, destination, point-of-interest or service information and may be green, brown or blue. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R19 | anchor: A02
Destination signs show directions or distances to places such as cities, airports and jurisdiction boundaries. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R20 | anchor: A02
The side of an exit sign on which the word Exit appears indicates whether the exit lane or ramp is on the left or right. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

FACT_ID: sec04-R21 | anchor: A02
A left-exit sign may use yellow to draw additional attention. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0034]

sections.heading: Traffic signs and work zones
sections.markdown:
# Traffic signs and work zones

FACT_ID: sec04-R22 | anchor: A03
Blue service signs with white letters or symbols identify amenities such as rest areas, fuel, lodging or hospitals. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec04-R23 | anchor: A03
The shape and color of a route-number marker indicate the roadway category. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec04-R24 | anchor: A03
Use a map or navigation system to plan a route and follow its route markers while traveling through unfamiliar areas. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec04-R25 | anchor: A03
Temporary incident signs warn of needed stops, closures or detours caused by unplanned events such as a crash, natural disaster or hazardous spill. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec04-R26 | anchor: A03
Incident signs use fluorescent pink backgrounds with black lettering. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec04-R27 | anchor: A03
The guide connects roadside-incident warnings with Louisiana’s move-over requirements. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0035]

FACT_ID: sec04-R28 | anchor: A04
Orange work-area warnings indicate nearby workers, machinery or barriers and may require slowing, stopping or changing lanes. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R29 | anchor: A04
Work-zone traffic controls can include signs, barricades, drums, cones, tubes, arrow panels and flag persons. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R30 | anchor: A04
Orange is the basic color for construction and maintenance traffic-control devices. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R31 | anchor: A04
Most work-area warning signs are diamonds, although some are rectangles. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R32 | anchor: A04
A Flagger Ahead warning calls for slowing and being prepared to stop for the flag person. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R33 | anchor: A04
A Workers Ahead warning calls for reduced speed and a lane position farther from workers. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R34 | anchor: A04
A Low Shoulder warning identifies a sharp drop at the pavement edge; if leaving the pavement, slow and steer firmly. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R35 | anchor: A04
Reduce speed in a work zone and remain prepared to stop. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R36 | anchor: A04
Reduced work-zone speed limits protect both road users and workers. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R37 | anchor: A04
The guide states that Louisiana construction-zone traffic fines are doubled. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0036]

FACT_ID: sec04-R38 | anchor: A05
Work-zone lane shifts or alternating closures may change daily, so familiar long-term work areas still require attention. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-R39 | anchor: A05
Barricades, vertical panels, drums, cones and tubes warn of unusual work-area conditions and guide traffic through the zone. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-R40 | anchor: A05
At night, work-area channelizing devices may carry flashing or steady lights. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-R41 | anchor: A05
Diagonal barricade stripes sloping down to the left direct traffic to pass on the left. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-R42 | anchor: A05
Diagonal barricade stripes sloping down to the right direct traffic to pass on the right. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec04-R43 | anchor: A05
Flashing or sequential arrow panels can guide vehicles into particular lanes and warn of a road or street closure during either daylight or darkness. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-la-e:louisiana-office-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0037]
